D-shaped whole envelope.representation: Complete solid exterior mass, semicircular north and straight south; no interior reconstruction

north entry.representation: Lower two-storey recess and side returns, approximate curved glazing and pale soffit

south upper bar and terminal piers.representation: Unbroken upper bar; horizontal windows and both solid end piers

west lower pocket.representation: Independent neutral closed-backed shallow indentation; exact glazing, depth and soffit not established; not east gate mirrored

east lower pocket.representation: Set-back glazing and simplified timber gate; no interior or detailed sign

roof.representation: Closed cap-bearing roof-level atrium, outer roof ring and low equipment; heights and cap count qualitative, no open court or multistorey roof drop

colour.representation: Original uncalibrated warm-brick, dark-glazing, pale-cap and timber palette, not photographic textures

omissions.representation: No neighbouring buildings, bus shelters, trees, signage glyphs, seal, interior, basement or measured terrain
